x: Golding and R. Braine also did well and we were pleased to see our Youths 880 yds. champion, D.
The bare team of four started and our first lad home was R. Braine in 21.23, closely followed by C.
Flanagan was 3rd in 18m. 13s. handing over to R.

The Youths' event proved one of those occasions when the selectors slipped up in the omission of J.K.Palmer, who has no club record but has been doing extremely well at Northampton. With the late arrival of R.
Palmer was recovering from an attack of flu otherwise he would have probably done better. We then had to go back to R.

At Bexley we finished only one complete team out of three just because the following failed to write or phone me despite sufficient warning :- R.Linstead, S.Charlton, S.Boreham, G.Lines, D.Manning and R.Braine.
